title: Input-head position bound after a run
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with a configuration $c$ on input $x$. After $t$ steps from $c$, the input-head position is at most its initial position plus $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
